builds.name: Reference: Ranked mid core
builds.goal: Reference for Zoe: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ mid players use most (2,753 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 52.3% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A ranged pick mage who uses terrain-extended sleep and long-travel Q for burst, then returns from a brief portal. Spell shards offer opportunistic movement and damage rather than a guaranteed loadout. The current mid provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Luden's Echo → Lich Bane → Shadowflame. Electrocute keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass.
builds.summary: The proven mid baseline: Luden's Echo → Lich Bane → Shadowflame, with Electrocute.
testPlan: Play it in mid as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Luden's Echo → Lich Bane → Shadowflame) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 52.3% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Luden's Echo → Lich Bane → Shadowflame.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Zoe dropkicks a bubble that deals [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage, lingering as a trap if it hits nothing. The bubble's range is extended when flying over terrain.

If either the bubble or trap hits an enemy champion she refreshes [(0.16 / 0.195 / 0.23 / 0.265 / 0.3) × 100]% of her cooldown.

After a delay, the victim falls Asleep and have their Magic Resist reduced by [30]% for 2 seconds. Attacks and Ability hits wake them up but deal double damage, up to [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.45) × AP] true damage.

Passive: Enemies drop spell shards when casting a Summoner Spell or using an Active Item. Specific minions also drop a spell shard when Zoe or a nearby ally kills them. Zoe can pick up this shard to cast that ability once.

Passive: When Zoe casts this Ability or any Summoner Spell, she gains [(0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7) × 100]% Move Speed for [2 / 2.25 / 2.5 / 2.75 / 3] seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. These missiles deal [15 / 25 / 35 / 45 / 55 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage each.

Active: Cast the Ability from a spell shard Zoe has picked up.

Zoe fires a star that deals increasing damage the further it travels to the first enemy hit and surrounding enemies -- between [50 / 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 14, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × AP] to [(50 / 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 14, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × AP) × (2.5)] magic damage.

Zoe can Recast this Ability to redirect the missile to a new position near Zoe.

After using an Ability, Zoe's next Attack deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=16, perLevel=4, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 8.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage.
Zoe teleports to a nearby position for 1 second. Afterwards, she teleports back. Zoe can use Abilities and Attack, but can't move during this time.

builds.name: Sparkles attack jump
builds.summary: Test sparkles attack jump against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test sparkles attack jump against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: More Sparkles adds 0.2 AP magic damage after each cast; Portal Jump grants one second to attack before forced return. Nashor and Lich Bane test that safe-looking attack window with a second spell to refresh passive, while bubble controls the target and Terminus fits mixed normal attacks.
testPlan: Required state: Land E and choose an R destination with safe return position.
Compare R-window attacks and incoming damage against a long-distance Q.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: One-second immobility and fixed return can expose Zoe; low spell burst loses picks.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The passive is refreshed by casts, not permanently added to every attack during R.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Terminus, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Survive the engage
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Zoe: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A ranged pick mage who uses terrain-extended sleep and long-travel Q for burst, then returns from a brief portal. Spell shards offer opportunistic movement and damage rather than a guaranteed loadout. Fix Q travel distance, Sleep state and the spell shard actually available. Lich Bane needs a real attack; Portal returns to a known point and cannot be treated as a permanent escape. A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
builds.summary: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
testPlan: Kit question for Zoe: Fix Q travel distance, Sleep state and the spell shard actually available. Lich Bane needs a real attack; Portal returns to a known point and cannot be treated as a permanent escape.

Start with the early core (Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.

The route fails Zoe's stated kit question: Fix Q travel distance, Sleep state and the spell shard actually available. Lich Bane needs a real attack; Portal returns to a known point and cannot be treated as a permanent escape.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.
Full cost 16,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Banshee's Veil, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Void Staff are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Bubble repeat control siege
builds.summary: Test bubble repeat control siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test bubble repeat control siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Sleepy Trouble Bubble refunds 16-30% of its cooldown when bubble/trap hits a champion; terrain extends reach and sleep reduces MR for two seconds. Torch and Liandry test persistent magic pressure while Horizon reveals long-range hits, but burn timing must preserve the intended Q wakeup.
testPlan: Required state: Hit E through terrain then deliver one well-timed long Q.
Record E cooldown and first wake packet with and without burns.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Burn or allied damage might wake early; trap misses provide no refund.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Sleep bonus has a damage cap and cannot double every damage-over-time tick.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
